payload.notes:
Split into two stacked PRs (combined diff was ~520 lines, over the 400-line hard ceiling), same pattern as E2-T04/E3-T01. #21 (branch sprint/3/e3-t02-session-state, base sprint/3/e3-t01-embedding-service): introduces the one session-state registry ADR-15 calls for (sessionState.service.ts) — module-level map, get-or-create, read-without-creating (never allocates), clear-one, clear-all (test affordance); rag.types.ts gains VectorIndexEntry + SessionState, deliberately left structured to grow (chat history in E3-T05, usage budgets in E3-T06) rather than built narrowly for the vector index alone. #22 (branch sprint/3/e3-t02-vector-index-search, base #21's branch): vectorIndex.service.ts (ADR-12) — brute-force cosine similarity over the plain array in SessionState.vectorIndex, vectors normalised to unit length defensively at both insert and query time, a dimension mismatch throwing the new EMBEDDING_DIMENSION_MISMATCH (500, ragErrors.ts), search capped at RAG.topK above RAG.minRelevanceScore descending by score; rag.types.ts gains RetrievedChunk + the frozen RAG constants. Merge #21 then #22.

Branch basing: E3-T01 (producer of Chunk/EmbeddedChunk) is Coder-complete and Reviewer-approved but not yet merged to main (PR #18-20). #21 stacks on E3-T01's own branch tip (sprint/3/e3-t01-embedding-service) rather than main, mirroring how E3-T01's own three PRs stacked on each other for the same reason (a real code/type dependency on an unmerged sibling). Full reasoning recorded in PR #21's description. Once T01 (then #21, #22) merge in order, no rebasing is needed on this side.

Tests use hand-built unit vectors with known dot products per design.md (no fake provider) for vectorIndex.service.ts: top-3 descending order, below-threshold queries returning fewer/zero results, dimension-mismatch throwing on both the index and search paths, and session-A-never-sees-session-B isolation. sessionState.service.ts tests cover get-or-create identity/persistence across calls, read-without-create never allocating, and clear-one vs clear-all isolation. Full suite green (119 tests) with both PRs' files present; typecheck passes. Also verified #21 alone (with #22's files removed) typechecks/tests standalone before committing #22.
